testcase.name: paired languages share exactly one line identity and source
empty or broken direct content never creates a blank track
track identity survives insertion reorder and translation refinement
duplicate prayers and repeated lines still have unique stable ids
abbreviations stay attached to their next word near a display boundary
reference abbreviations do not split a single source verse
unrelated stage and missing day do not borrow another reading
packaged prayers and dated readings produce complete usable player tracks
daily track ids include date and text revision for safe saved positions
long verses split at readable word boundaries without changing source wording
selected text meaning context and scripture identity remain available to the screen
a single long token is kept intact and never causes an endless split
legacy text remains one aligned block without guessing sentence pairs
matching daily readings follow the introduction and keep source verse boundaries
recognizable prayer title takes precedence without changing track identity
